title: 스와이프
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with soft rock influences. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. A warm acoustic piano provides harmonic support. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a melodic, walking feel. Drums feature a crisp snare and prominent hi-hat work. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth tenor range, transitioning into a powerful, belted chest voice during the chorus. The arrangement builds with a string section providing sustained legato pads. Key of E Major. Tempo is 74 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated clean electric guitar with chorus effect]
[soft piano chords]

[Verse 1]
[smooth male tenor vocals]
헤어지자는 말을 [bass guitar enters]
웃으면서 했어
카페 창가에 앉아서 [light hi-hat taps]
라떼를 마시면서
날씨 좋다 오늘
그러고는 우리 여기까지 하자 [kick drum enters]
웃으면서

[Chorus]
[full drum kit enters, driving backbeat]
[string section pads]
웃고 있잖아 왜 웃고 있어
이별인데 왜 웃고 있어
나도 따라 웃었어 [snare rolls]
멍청하게
눈물이 나려는데 이꼬리가 올라가
